1. (Original) [Claim 1 not provided in current claims listing; presumed to be independent claim upon which claims 2-5 depend]

2. (Currently amended) The automated communications system of claim 1 wherein the routing-and-message-forwarding component determines whether or not the message is authorized to be forwarded by: parsing the destination address into an ordered sequence of nodes; and for each node of the ordered sequence of nodes, determining whether the source address is authorized to send a message to that node __by accessing stored authorization information within the automated communications system__.

3. (Currently amended) The automated communications system of claim 1 wherein the routing-and-message-forwarding component determines whether or not the message is authorized to be forwarded by: parsing the destination address into an ordered sequence of nodes; and for each node of the ordered sequence of nodes, determining whether the source address is authorized to send a message to that node by __accessing stored authorization information within the automated communications system that authorizes the source address, and when the source address is authorized to send a message to the node, returning an indication of success__.

4. (Currently amended) The automated communications system of claim 1 wherein the routing-and-message-forwarding component determines whether or not the message is authorized to be forwarded by: parsing the destination address into an ordered sequence of nodes; and for each node of the ordered sequence of nodes, determining whether the source address is authorized to send a message to that node by __accessing stored authorization information within the automated communications system to determine whether information blocking messages with the source address is absent, and when the source address is authorized to send a message to the node, returning an indication of success__.

5. (Currently amended) The automated communications system of claim 1 wherein the routing-and-message-forwarding component determines whether or not the message is authorized to be forwarded by: parsing the destination address into an ordered sequence of nodes and/or node-token pairs; and for each node and/or node-token pair of the ordered sequence of nodes and/or node-token pairs, determining whether the source address is authorized to send a message to the node by __accessing stored authorization information within the automated communications system to determine whether information blocking messages with the source address is absent, whether information authorizing the source address is present, and/or whether any rules that apply to the message are satisfied, and when the source address is not authorized to send a message to the node, returning an indication of failure, and when the source address is authorized to send a message to the node, accessing stored information within the automated communications system to determine whether or not a token associated with the node-token pair is valid, when the token is not valid, returning an indication of failure, and when the token is valid, returning an indication of success__.
